affected_subject.reason: GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory and launchpad pairs with reward fee mechanism are identified.

trigger_or_action.reason: Attacker front-runs createPair for LaunchToken:quoteToken before launchpad's createPair at bonding end.

direct_effect.reason: Pre-existing Type A pair causes PAIR_EXISTS revert and launchpad uses pair with disabled reward distribution.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Uniqueness of pair per token combination plus first-caller-wins yields expected-vs-actual state relation where launchpad should create fee-enabled pair but instead uses attacker's pair.

summary: Report identifies factory/pair subject, front-running trigger, disabled reward distribution effect, and pair-uniqueness safety relation; sufficient to attempt formalization.
